note: The Mechs kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). The kit sheet hands these to KratorMechs.useTextures(): each bucket's map is a grey DETAIL map sampled by triplanar projection of the bind-pose position (no UVs), its mean brightness divided back out so the vertex colours (the Iziz livery) keep their brightness, and its luminance used as a bump. scale is metres per tile. plate: bare and grey-painted armour (riveted patchwork); livery: the orange, cream and teal paint (chipped painted plate: where the map is dark the paint gives way to steel); metal: joints, frames and pistons (machined steel with grease); bronze: phalerae, suns and trim; cloth: padding, rope, leather, feathers; hair: the horsehair crests; banner: the vexilla (the orb device); sunbanner: the sun flags (a window from one tile: the generated sheet is not quite periodic). The bundle itself carries no images: a host world that wants them passes its own. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py kits/mechs after any change, then python3 build.py.
